teaser_duration_s.source: ffprobe of «تشويقة_قضية سمرقند.mp4»; picture 1920x862 inside 1920x1080, 24 fps

teaser_partner_logo.source: teaser 2.5-3.5 s, after the studio's logo

notes: Stills 1-5 of Art/stills/samarqand are 1:1 crops of comic pages 2, 3, 19, 25 and 38; they were located in the pages and re-cut from the lossless PNGs. The teaser has narration subtitles burned into the picture (rows 852-905). Its frames and loops are cut from the subtitle-free top of the picture at the teaser's own 2.23:1 (crop=1637:735:141:110); the eyes frame is cut at 2.39:1 because that shot has its own black bar at the top.

logo_source.logo-white.webp: «شعار قضية سمرقند.png» in /Volumes/Sigma Drive/Downloads Archive - Sep 2026 (cream lettering with a brown extruded shadow, 646x360). The cream faces were kept and recoloured white, the brown shadow dropped, 400 px wide. The file is the one the teaser's After Effects project links as ملحقات/شعار قضية سمرقند.png
